Our studio in Ottawa is Nuzzlesprig Books, and we're making The Lantern in the Snow, a children's picture book about woodland creatures sharing a little light through winter. There are rather a lot of pencil shavings around here already. With Christmas gift shopping underway, we love the idea of someone giving a book with their own illustration inside.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "We're Nuzzlesprig Books, an Ottawa studio hosting a free drawing contest: illustrate a woodland creature carrying a lantern for our children's picture book, The Lantern in the Snow. Our judges will choose one illustration for originality and storytelling, and its creator will receive a printed copy featuring their artwork to keep or give as a Christmas gift. Entry is open to residents of the United States and Canada aged 21 or older under our submission policy, with no purchase required. Submit your drawing by December 2, 2026."

Please run our X campaign from Wednesday, November 25, 2026 through Wednesday, December 2, 2026, inclusive—all eight days in the account's time zone, Eastern time. The landing page is https://nuzzlesprigbooks.com/draw. We want as many completed entries to the free contest as possible; entries are what we count. Only residents of the United States and Canada aged 21 or older can enter, as our submission policy requires.

Our site has X's pixel installed, and it reports each completed entry to X as "Drawing entered". You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please watch it throughout the flight, and when it ends, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 750.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
